chunks: And Al-'Ala' narrated from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both), who said:
I asked him about sleeping after the morning prayer, so he said: 'Indeed, sustenance is spread out during that hour, so I dislike that a man should sleep during that hour.'
ai.seo_question: Why is sleeping after Fajr prayer discouraged in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, the Imam (peace be upon him) advises against sleeping after the morning prayer, identifying this specific time as a period when sustenance (rizq) is distributed. This recommendation highlights the spiritual and physical importance of remaining awake to capture divine blessings, a view supported by Shia scholars who emphasize the virtue of early morning activity for both worship and worldly provision.
